blogs.title: Decoding the Diaphragm: Imaging Giant Masses in Pregnancy without the Gadolinium
blogs.description: Explore the step‑by‑step process of diagnosing large abdominal lesions during pregnancy, comparing the strengths and limitations of ultrasound, bimanual examination, and non‑contrast MRI. Learn how to differentiate decidualised endometriomas from cystic leiomyomas, recognize imaging pitfalls, and apply safety guidelines for MRI in the second trimester.

blogs.title: The CA‑125 Puzzle: When Pregnancy Distorts Tumor Markers
blogs.description: Delve into the physiological peaks of CA‑125 in early, mid, and late pregnancy, and examine how rising values can mimic malignancy. The post explains serial marker trends, cutoff adjustments, and how to integrate CA‑125 results with imaging to improve diagnostic accuracy for uterine and adnexal masses.

blogs.title: Cutting Through Obstacles: Mid‑Trimester Myomectomy – When and How
blogs.description: A practical guide to the decision‑making process for performing myomectomy during the second trimester. Coverage includes indications, surgical timing, laparotomy versus laparoscopy, preserving uterine integrity, and strategies to minimize blood loss and preterm labor.

blogs.title: From Laparotomy to Baby: Delivery Planning in the Presence of Uterine Giants
blogs.description: Discuss the complexities of mode of delivery when large intramural or pedunculated fibroids could obstruct the birth canal. Review evidence on elective cesarean timing, uterine scar considerations, and how residual masses influence vaginal versus surgical birth.

blogs.title: Bleeding Behind the Belly: Iron‑Deficiency and Blood Management in Pregnant Surgery
blogs.description: Address the unique challenges of anemia management in pregnant patients undergoing abdominal surgery. Topics include transfusion thresholds, the role of iron supplementation, perioperative blood conservation techniques, and monitoring for fetal oxygenation.

blogs.title: Prophylactic Shield: Progesterone, Antibiotics, and Anesthesia to Safeguard Pregnancy
blogs.description: Outline a perioperative safety bundle for pregnant patients—including intra‑operative prophylactic antibiotics, postoperative progesterone regimens, and anesthetic considerations—to reduce maternal infection and preterm labor risks after major abdominal surgery.
